summary: Russian forces struck a Kiev missile control production facility manufacturing Flamingo, Neptune, FP-7, and FP-9 systems, while a nationwide drone campaign hit multiple oblasts including Kyiv, Odesa, Poltava, and Chernihiv directions. Ukrainian strikes damaged Russia's Syzran refinery (71% capacity) and Saratov refinery halted processing. The conflict is expanding into an economic two-front war with new US sanctions and European military infrastructure buildup.

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces struck a Kiev enterprise manufacturing missile control systems for Flamingo, Neptune, FP-7, and FP-9, while a multi-axis drone campaign hit Kyiv, Odesa, Poltava, Kharkiv, and Chernihiv directions. Ukrainian attacks damaged Syzran refinery's main processing unit (71% capacity) and halted Saratov refinery operations. The war is expanding into an economic dimension with new US sanctions and European military infrastructure mobilization.
ukraine: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Russian refineries: Syzran main unit (71% capacity) damaged, repairs 1+ month; Saratov stopped processing; Yaroslavl claimed struck. Targeting oil refining infrastructure to shift war into economic sphere (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33380)

Ukrainian forces struck a Kiev data center and missile control production facility manufacturing Flamingo, Neptune, FP-7, FP-9 systems, providing intelligence data and AFU network equipment operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33381)
